description: Configuration for VB.NET to .NET 9 / React migration tech stacks
structure:
Below is the recommended structure for a modern .NET 9 web application, following best practices for separation of concerns, maintainability, and scalability. This structure is designed to support a clean architecture approach, with clear boundaries between the presentation layer, business logic, and data access layers. This is a mockup of a typical .NET 9 web application structure, which can be adapted based on specific project requirements with **Clean Architecture** principles in mind.

YourProject/
├── src/                                # Source code for the application
│   ├── YourProject.API/                # PRESENTATION LAYER - Web API controllers and HTTP handling
│   │   ├── Controllers/                # API endpoints and HTTP request handlers
│   │   │   ├── AccountController.cs    # Handles user authentication and account management
│   │   │   ├── AdvancedSearchController.cs # Configures advanced search functionality
│   │   │   ├── CustomerController.cs   # Implements customer-related operations
│   │   │   ├── ReportController.cs     # Handles reporting functionality with authorization
│   │   │   ├── HomeController.cs       # Handles requests for home pages and search functionality
│   │   │   └── OrderController.cs      # Manages order data operations
│   │   ├── Models/                     # API-specific DTOs, ViewModels, Request/Response models
│   │   │   ├── Requests/               # API request models for various operations
│   │   │   │   ├── QueryRequest.cs     # Request model for query operations
│   │   │   │   ├── ReportRequest.cs    # Request model for report operations
│   │   │   │   └── SearchRequest.cs    # Request model for search operations
│   │   │   ├── Responses/              # API response models
│   │   │   │   ├── QueryResponse.cs    # Response model for query results
│   │   │   │   ├── ReportResponse.cs   # Response model for report results
│   │   │   │   └── SearchResponse.cs   # Response model for search results
